name: Lucky Lager x9990

features.name: Multiplier machine bonus
features.description: A three-reel pop-up reveals a multiplier up to 999x.

features.name: Extra multipliers
features.description: More bonus symbols can boost the result.

review:
Oktoberfest on 10 lines – pretzels, sausages, pints and kegs, with a beer-garden girl as the scatter.

The bonus pops up a three-reel machine that spins numbers into a multiplier up to 999x, applied to your bet – and the more bonus symbols triggered it, the more extra multipliers you can get. Very high volatility, 10,490x max and 96.1% RTP. Most of the upside lives in rare, big triggers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
